title.zh: SEC and CFTC bypass Congress to open crypto access after CLARITY fails  – with a catch
title.en: SEC and CFTC bypass Congress to open crypto access after CLARITY fails  – with a catch

current_state.zh: 在参议院未能推进CLARITY法案后，SEC为合格平台提供了五年期条件性豁免以进行特定代币化股票交易，CFTC扩大了针对被动软件提供商的无行动救济，并且CFTC现已向OMB提交加密市场规则提案等待审查，之后还需CFTC投票和公开征求意见才能生效。
current_state.en: After the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, the SEC created a five-year conditional exemption for qualifying platforms to trade certain tokenized stocks, the CFTC broadened no-action relief for passive software providers, and the CFTC has now submitted a crypto market rules proposal to OMB for review, with a CFTC vote and public comment still needed before it can take effect.

updates.title_en: SEC and CFTC bypass Congress to open crypto access after CLARITY fails  – with a catch
updates.what_changed_zh: After the Senate failed to advance the CLARITY Act, the SEC created a five-year conditional path for permissioned venues to trade tokenized US stocks via automated market makers, while the CFTC broadened no-action relief for software providers connecting users to regulated derivatives markets.

updates.title_zh: CFTC sends crypto rules to White House to review as Congress stalls on Clarity Act
updates.title_en: CFTC sends crypto rules to White House to review as Congress stalls on Clarity Act
updates.what_changed_zh: CFTC于周四向白宫管理和预算办公室（OMB）提交了一份新的加密市场规则提案，该提案在OMB审查后将返回CFTC进行投票和公开征求意见。
updates.what_changed_en: The CFTC submitted a new crypto market rules proposal to the White House Office of Management and Budget (OMB) on Thursday; after OMB review, it will return to the CFTC for a vote and public comment.
updates.current_state_zh: 在参议院未能推进CLARITY法案后，SEC为合格平台提供了五年期条件性豁免以进行特定代币化股票交易，CFTC扩大了针对被动软件提供商的无行动救济，并且CFTC现已向OMB提交加密市场规则提案等待审查，之后还需CFTC投票和公开征求意见才能生效。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: The CFTC sent a crypto market proposal to the White House for review after the CLARITY Act failed in the Senate, while the SEC introduced a five-year conditional exemption for qualifying tokenized-stock platforms and the CFTC issued no-action relief for certain passive software providers.
